message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes:

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------|
| **Siam Thai** | 1111 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | <https://siamthai.com> | *Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian version)*, *Pad Thai* (no egg), *Green Curry* (with tofu), *Thai Basil Rice* |
| **Baan Thai** | 2000 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60614 | (312) 555‑1234 | <https://baanthai.com> | *Vegetable Spring Rolls*, *Massaman Curry* (tofu), *Pad Krapow* (tofu), *Coconut Rice* |
| **Thai Orchid** | 1500 W 19th St, Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 555‑5678 | <https://thaiorchid.com> | *Vegetarian Tom Kha Soup*, *Pad See Ew* (no egg), *Red Curry* (tofu), *Sticky Rice* |
| **Bangkok Bistro** | 1700 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 555‑9012 | <https://bangkokbistro.com> | *Vegetarian Green Papaya Salad*, *Pad Kee Mao* (no egg), *Thai Basil Fried Rice* (no egg), *Mango Sticky Rice* |

### Quick Tips
- **Call Ahead** – If you’re planning a larger group or have specific dietary restrictions, it’s a good idea to call ahead and confirm that vegetarian options are available for your order.
- **Ask for “No Egg”** – Many Thai dishes contain eggs; simply ask for “no egg” if you’re avoiding them.
- **Check Online Menus** – Most of these restaurants list vegetarian options on their websites or on platforms like Yelp and Google Maps.

Enjoy your Thai meal in Chicago!
